generations.title: Cozy ritual + box arrives

generations.basis: MF 63K opening (hooks REPORT §3 decor alternative: 'cosy dim family couch scene with the box carried in by 1 s').
generations.prompt:
Image-to-video from the start image. A dim, cozy American living room at night, a family of four on the couch under a blanket watching a Christmas movie, a golden retriever on the rug, an American flag on the wall. Within the first second dad walks in from the left carrying the {brand} box and sets it on the coffee table; the kids sit up. Locked camera. Natural sound only: TV dialogue murmur, footsteps. No music, no text.
shot on iphone 12, no warm lighting, no blur, nothing cinematic, make it look as organic as possible, remove the caption and the emojis. when recreating do not make the video grainy or sharp in any way, remake it as if it was freshly refilmed 4k iphone 12 footage.
